# MOTOC Cloud Data Sanitizer v0.1.0-rc.7

## Release Status

This build is a **Release Candidate** intended for **evaluation only**.

## Overview

MOTOC Cloud Data Sanitizer is a local-first desktop application for CSV/XLSX
billing preparation with sensitive identifier protection.

## Changes

- Release documentation alignment
- Public release preparation

**No functional changes.**

## Security

- No cloud connection
- No automatic upload
- No credential collection
